name: ResponsiveImg - Serves A Photo With Its Srcset
description: The only visual state this component has. Its two branches - the build step produced width variants, or it did not - render identically on screen; the difference is srcset/sizes/width/height in the markup, which no screenshot can show, and which src/lib/responsiveImage.test.ts pins instead. What this frame guards is that the component renders its photo at container width rather than collapsing to a broken tile, which is what a wrong path or a thrown manifest read would produce. Bounded to 760px, the widest real bounded use (the /donate testimonial event photo); the hero uses are full-bleed and unbounded.
